scope: Reuse the existing p1_p1 and m2_p1 denominator-cleared scalar formulae and bind their two coefficients to the current pairedQuad program. This is the first intermediate step of the missing coefficient clearing proof.
reuse_decisions: Reuse the original linearA/B/D and quadraticA/B/D formulas; no new polynomial arrays for these two moments.
Import only the original generic LightMoments. Its Complex specialization would duplicate an evaluation interface already checked in the full36moment program and is unnecessary.
New local adapter must prove equality of both actual Quad coefficients, not merely evaluation at one assumed root. All divisor hypotheses remain explicit.
Remaining34moment clearings require source review/appropriate binding and the final66term numerator identity remains separate.
Literal map from existing Quad to Mathlib.QuadraticAlgebra reuses its already proved ring/projection/involution infrastructure. No second quadratic ring implementation or new coefficient arrays.
